verdict.rationale: OpenHands is fundamentally natural-language driven: CLI and GUI let users type natural language tasks and get instant feedback, resume conversations, and control the agent with simple commands, and the browser-use integration explicitly works 'through natural language instructions.' This is corroborated by official docs and a CLI probe confirming the interface exists. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports validating real-world natural-language robustness beyond vendor docs.
